title: Choosing the Country Life - a bit about me
en: in this video i would like to share a little bit about moving to the countryside i know that many are curious as to the steps that i took to make this happen and i will be sharing more about that on my instagram page in order to get into the details but in short the answers to those questions are simple no i'm not wealthy and yes i have to work hard to be able to live here it isn't easy and living rurally comes with its own set of struggles the opportunity to work here as a teacher was offered to me about two years ago but at the time i wasn't sure whether or not to take it i had a life and job as a clerk and while my environment suited my siblings who both live in cities my spirit was restless it was cathartic when i realized that that was not where i was meant to be also that i was terrified of change that was the hard part stepping into the unknown taking the risk that things might not work out with my job finances and long-term sense of fulfillment but i think that's true for many things in life the first step is by far the hardest

do for the sake of context my father works in the military and consequently i grew up moving from place to place by the time i was 20 i'd lived in several countries and was pretty well traveled moving here was terrifying because i couldn't imagine being somewhere without inevitably leaving it but there was something about this place and i knew i'd found my home if i could give only one piece of advice to anyone seeking to live in the countryside it is to come here with intention in these parts of the world where nature is thriving you are a steward and must seek to live in alignment with your surroundings that involves learning about your local habitats and animals and how your choices directly impact them in this day and age we must live by this philosophy that by being here we are representatives and protectors of course no matter where you live you can adopt this philosophy as well do

for example my town has come together to defend their home when mining companies wish to take advantage of natural resources if there had been no humans here it could have happened without even making the news work parties pick up the garbage that accumulates on the roads after tourist season many make efforts to control the spread of noxious weeds by scanning their properties every year it's not easy to live out here and it comes with great responsibility i seek to give my love to the earth in any way i can even though my relationship always has room for improvement but that's why i came here to learn ow that autumn is in full swing the now that autumn is in full swing the rain has come to my valley and i am so grateful for it it is a blessing on this earth and i wanted to go out and witness it myself

so my favorite place to experience the rainfall is in the mountains but as i climbed i realized that something much more exciting was in store and that was one of the first snowfalls of the season it was so magical that i simply had to take you along you
zh: 在这个视频中，我想分享一些关于搬到农村的事情，我知道很多人对我为实现这一目标所采取的步骤感到好奇，我将在我的 Instagram 页面上分享更多相关信息，以便了解详细信息，但简而言之，这些问题的答案很简单，不，我并不富裕，是的，我必须努力工作才能住在这里，这并不容易，农村生活也有自己的一系列斗争，大约两年前，有人向我提供了在这里当老师的机会，但是当时我不确定是否要接受这个职位，我的生活和工作是一名文员，虽然我的环境适合我的兄弟姐妹，他们都生活在城市里，但当我意识到那不是我应该去的地方时，我的精神却焦躁不安，这是一种宣泄，当我意识到那不是我应该去的地方时，我也害怕改变，这是踏入未知世界的困难部分，冒着事情可能无法顺利进行的风险，因为我的工作财务和长期的成就感，但我认为对于生活中的许多事情来说，第一步是迄今为止最难的

出于背景考虑，我父亲在军队工作，因此我从小就从一个地方搬到另一个地方，在我20岁的时候，我住过几个国家，经常旅行，搬到这里是很可怕的，因为我无法想象在某个地方而不不可避免地离开它，但这个地方有一些东西，我知道我已经找到了我的家，如果我只能给任何想要在乡村生活的人一个建议，那就是带着意图来到世界上这些自然繁荣的地方，你是一个管家，必须寻求与周围环境保持一致，包括了解当地的栖息地和动物，以及您的选择如何直接影响当今时代的动物，我们必须遵循这一理念，即在这里，我们是代表和保护者，当然，无论您住在哪里，您也可以采用这一理念
例如，当矿业公司希望利用自然资源时，我的城镇就团结起来保卫自己的家园，如果这里没有人类，甚至不用让新闻工作组去捡起旅游旺季后路上堆积的垃圾，许多人每年都通过扫描自己的财产来努力控制有毒杂草的蔓延，在这里生活并不容易，而且责任重大。在这里学习秋天已经如火如荼 现在秋天已经如火如荼 雨已经来到了我的山谷，我非常感激它，这是地球上的祝福，我想出去亲眼目睹
所以我最喜欢体验降雨的地方是在山里，但当我爬上去时，我意识到更令人兴奋的事情正在等待着，那是这个季节的第一场降雪之一，它是如此神奇，我不得不带你一起去
